newsitem.title: USA: Intel Q3 chip, chipset shipments hit record.
newsitem.headline: Intel Q3 chip, chipset shipments hit record.

text.p: Intel Corp said Monday its third quarter unit shipments of microprocessor chips and chipsets set new records, though its flash memory, embedded processors and microcontroller unit shipments fell slightly compared with the second quarter.
In a written statement, Intel said the percentage of motherboards to microprocessors also declined in the third quarter versus the second.
It continued to see high levels of orders for immediate delivery, or turns, as they are called in the industry.
Earlier, Intel reported share earnings of $1.48 in the quarter versus $1.05 one year ago.
